title: Revision of Client-Level Position Limits for Index Derivatives and Periodic Review of Internal Limit Frameworks
content:
FICTIONAL DEMO CIRCULAR — NOT AN ACTUAL SEBI PUBLICATION.

To,
The Managing Directors / Chief Executive Officers,
All Recognised Stock Exchanges and Clearing Corporations having Equity Derivatives Segment;
All Stock Brokers and Clearing Members.

Sub: Revision of Client-Level Position Limits for Index Derivatives and Periodic Review of Internal Limit Frameworks

1. Background
1.1. Client-level position limits for index futures and index options were last revised in 2020 and are prescribed as fixed notional caps. Representations have been received that fixed caps no longer reflect market depth, and that intermediaries review their internal limit frameworks only annually, which delays adoption of revised limits.

2. Revised client-level position limits
2.1. With effect from the effective date in paragraph 5, the client-level gross position limit for index futures and index options shall be the higher of Rs. 1,500 crore notional or 15 percent of the total open interest in the underlying index, in place of the existing Rs. 500 crore notional or 15 percent of open interest.
2.2. The net position limit in near-month index options at the client level shall be Rs. 500 crore notional, in place of Rs. 250 crore.
2.3. Client-level limits shall be linked to the client's net worth or collateral posted, as certified to the stock broker, and shall not be applied as a fixed cap irrespective of the client's net worth.

3. Periodic review of internal limit frameworks
3.1. Every stock broker and clearing member shall review its internal position limit policy at least once every six months, and in any case within 30 calendar days of any circular issued by SEBI or a recognised stock exchange revising position limits.
3.2. The internal policy shall expressly provide for interim adoption of revised regulatory limits pending approval by the intermediary's board or risk committee.

4. Monitoring and reporting
4.1. Stock exchanges shall monitor client-level positions against the revised limits on an end-of-day basis and report breaches to SEBI in the existing format.
4.2. Penal provisions for breach of position limits shall continue to apply as prescribed.

5. Applicability and effective date
5.1. This circular is applicable to all stock brokers, clearing members, recognised stock exchanges and clearing corporations in the equity derivatives segment.
5.2. The provisions of this circular shall come into effect 30 days from the date of issue, i.e. on October 15, 2026.
5.3. Stock brokers shall amend their internal policies and confirm compliance to the stock exchanges within 30 days of the date of this circular.

6. This circular is issued in exercise of the powers conferred under Section 11(1) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India Act, 1992 (fictional reference for demonstration).

Yours faithfully,
Demo Signatory
General Manager (fictional)
